name: Pulse Dark
tagline: Dark mode for every website. Free, unlimited, private.
overview: Pulse Dark is a Chrome extension that turns every website dark the moment it loads, in a way that looks right instead of just inverted: photos keep their colors, buttons and prices stay readable, and already-dark sites are left alone. Sliders, themes and one-tap loadouts set the look; Fix this site, Try another way and Pick a part and recolor it handle the pages that break. Free, unlimited websites, no account, and your settings never leave your browser.

capabilities.title: Every website goes dark as it loads
capabilities.text: Bright pages turn dark the moment they load, with no white flash. Buttons, prices and links keep their own colors.

capabilities.title: One big ON/OFF switch
capabilities.text: The big switch turns dark on or off on every site at once.

capabilities.title: Dim it or brighten it
capabilities.text: Six sliders (Brightness, Contrast, Color, Warmth, Dim, Gray) change the page live, for every site or only this one.

capabilities.title: Loadouts: a whole look in one tap

Invert+

Simple

capabilities.title: Dark icons stay visible
capabilities.text: Dark icons that would vanish on a dark background are flipped light.

proofs.caption: Before: dark icons on a white pill
After: the pill is dark and the icons are light

capabilities.title: Pictures stay true
capabilities.text: Product photos and pictures keep their real colors; only the page around them goes dark.

proofs.caption: Before: product cards on white
After: same photos, same colors, dark cards

capabilities.title: Already-dark sites are left alone
capabilities.text: A site designed dark is noticed and left exactly as it is.

capabilities.title: Uniform: one color for a whole site
capabilities.text: Paints a whole site one calm color, colored headers and bars included. Pictures stay untouched.

proofs.caption: Popup: Uniform is on here
The blue header bar joins the one dark color

capabilities.title: Flatten this site
capabilities.text: Colored headers, panels and buttons go dark too, for a fully dark look.

capabilities.title: Pick a part and recolor it

The recolor panel: what, color, where

capabilities.title: Dark, Filtered or Normal per site

proofs.caption: Popup: Filtered for this site
Filtered: the site's own colors, only your sliders apply
Normal: this site is left alone

capabilities.title: Fix this site
capabilities.text: A three-step helper for a page that looks wrong: try another engine, nudge brightness and contrast, then keep it or put it back.

proofs.caption: The Fix this site steps

capabilities.title: Pause dark on one tab
capabilities.text: When colors matter (shopping, photos), pause dark on this tab for 15 minutes, an hour or until tomorrow. It comes back by itself.

proofs.caption: Paused on this tab, with the time it comes back and Resume now
The tab shows the site's real colors meanwhile

capabilities.title: Undo
capabilities.text: Walks back your last change, up to 50 of them.

proofs.caption: A change: this site set to Normal
Tap Undo: back to Dark

capabilities.title: Plain-words help
capabilities.text: The ghost "i" explains every button in plain words.

proofs.caption: Popup help panel

capabilities.title: Screen shader
capabilities.text: A see-through tint over every page (warm amber, night red or plain dim), on top of any engine.

proofs.caption: Warm amber tint over a dark article

capabilities.title: Easier-to-read font
capabilities.text: Swap every site's text to a font that's easier for you to read, and make thin text thicker.

proofs.caption: Verdana with thicker text on the same article

capabilities.title: Schedule, evening warmth, shortcuts
capabilities.text: Dark always, following the computer, at set times or sunset to sunrise; evening warmth on its own timer; keyboard shortcuts (Alt+Shift+D, Alt+Shift+S) and a right-click menu.

proofs.caption: Options: When is dark on, Evening warmth, Shortcuts and right-click menu

capabilities.title: Printing stays light
capabilities.text: Printing always uses the page's original light look, so no ink is wasted.

proofs.caption: The print view of a darkened article: light, as the site made it

capabilities.title: Custom CSS and recipes
capabilities.text: Your own style fix for one site, and site-fix files you can share or bring in.

proofs.caption: Options: Custom CSS for one site, Recipes

capabilities.title: All settings in one file
capabilities.text: Save every setting to one file and bring it back on another browser.

proofs.caption: Options: Save settings file, Bring settings back

capabilities.title: Community site fixes built in
capabilities.text: Small fixes for 2,839 sites (from the Dark Reader project, MIT License) ship inside every update. Nothing is downloaded.

capabilities.title: Dark PDFs
capabilities.text: PDFs that open in the browser go dark too.

capabilities.title: Private by design
capabilities.text: No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Settings stay in this browser; the About page lists every permission and why.

proofs.caption: Options: About, what it is allowed to do and why, and your change history

capabilities.text: The welcome page says what just happened and where the switch lives. No account, nothing to fill in.

proofs.caption: Welcome page shown right after install
